app.title: Install Sloth OS
welcome.heading: Welcome to Sloth OS!
welcome.text: You can try the system without installing it, or install it on your computer. Installing takes a few minutes and just a few questions.
region.heading: Keyboard and time zone
region.try_keyboard_hint: Type here to check the layout
region.note: You can change these later in System Settings.
account.heading: Create your account
account.text: You'll sign in to the computer with this name and password. Your account will be an administrator, so you can also change the computer's settings.
account.note: You can choose what the computer asks your password for on first start, in Sloth Welcome.
account.error.name: Enter your name.
account.error.username: The username can only contain lowercase English letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores, and must start with a letter (e.g. “anna”).
disk.heading: Where should we install it?
disk.text: Choose the disk Sloth OS will be installed on.
disk.none: We couldn't find a disk to install on.
disk.too_small: Too small: at least 40 GB is needed.
disk.contents.linux: Has a Linux system on it
disk.removable: This is an external drive (e.g. a USB stick). Are you sure you want to install here?
disk.small: A bit tight: at least 120 GB is recommended for games.
disk.beside.option: Next to Windows (Windows and its files are kept)
disk.beside.erase: Erase the whole disk (Windows and all files are lost)
disk.beside.size: Space for Sloth OS: {size} GB (at most {max} GB)
disk.beside.not_uefi: This computer started in legacy (BIOS) mode, so we can't install next to Windows. If your computer supports it, turn on UEFI mode in its settings and start from the USB drive again.
disk.beside.not_gpt: This disk uses an old-style (MBR) partition table, so we can't install next to Windows.
disk.beside.hibernated: Windows didn't fully shut down (fast startup or hibernation), so we can't touch its drive right now. Start Windows, turn off fast startup (Control Panel → Power Options → Choose what the power buttons do), then choose Restart and start the computer from the USB drive.
disk.beside.dirty: A disk check is due on the Windows drive. Start Windows, wait until it finishes, then start the computer from the USB drive.
disk.beside.unknown: We couldn't check the Windows drive, so we won't resize it.
disk.beside.bitlocker: The Windows drive is encrypted with BitLocker and can't be made smaller from here. In Windows, open Disk Management (right-click drive C: → Shrink Volume), free up at least 40 GB, then start the installer again: we'll install into the freed space.
disk.beside.no_space: There isn't enough space next to Windows: Sloth OS needs at least 40 GB, and Windows needs some free space too.
disk.encrypt.hint: If your computer is stolen or lost, nobody can get to your files. You'll need to enter the password every time you turn it on.
disk.encrypt.warning: If you forget this password, your files can't be recovered. Write it down and keep it somewhere safe.
disk.encrypt.short: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
disk.encrypt.short_same: Your account password is shorter than 8 characters: enter a longer, separate password for encryption.
confirm.heading: Everything on this disk will be erased
confirm.text: Sloth OS uses the whole disk: {disk}. Everything on it now (files, programs, other systems) will be permanently deleted.
confirm.windows: This disk has Windows on it. After installing, Windows and all its files will be gone. If you want to keep them, back up your files first.
confirm.checkbox: I understand that all data on the disk will be erased
confirm.beside.heading: Windows stays
confirm.beside.text: Sloth OS gets {size} GB on this disk: {disk}. Windows and its files are kept.
confirm.beside.shrink: To do this, we make the Windows drive {size} GB smaller. This is usually safe, but if something goes wrong in the meantime (for example a power cut), data could be lost, so back up your important files first.
confirm.beside.free: It goes into the free space on the disk; Windows is not touched.
confirm.beside.bitlocker: Windows is encrypted with BitLocker: it may ask for the recovery key the next time it starts. Keep it at hand (aka.ms/myrecoverykey).
confirm.beside.menu: When the computer starts, you can choose between Sloth OS and Windows for a few seconds.
confirm.beside.checkbox: I understand, and I have backed up my important files
confirm.encrypt: The disk will be encrypted: it opens with your password when the computer starts.
stage.copy: Copying Sloth OS to the disk…
install.note: Depending on your computer, this takes 5–20 minutes. Please don't turn it off.
done.heading: Installation complete!
done.text: Restart your computer. When the screen goes dark, unplug the USB stick. Then sign in with the account you just created, and Sloth Welcome will help with the rest.
done.beside: When the computer starts, you can choose between Sloth OS and Windows.
error.heading: Installation failed
error.log_hint: If you ask for help, the details are in /tmp/sloth-install.log.
error.not_authorized: We didn't get permission to install.
error.bad_disk: This disk can't be installed on. Please choose another one.
error.bad_input: One of the settings is invalid. Go back and check them.
error.install_failed: Something went wrong while copying the system to the disk. Data previously on the disk may already have been erased.
error.configure_failed: The system was installed, but setting the language and keyboard failed. Try again; if it still fails, you can set them in System Settings after the first start.
error.beside_shrink_failed: We couldn't make the Windows drive smaller. Start Windows, check the disk (This PC → C: → Properties → Tools → Check), then try again.
error.encrypt_failed: Setting up encryption didn't work. Try again; if it still fails, install without encryption.
desktop.comment: Install Sloth OS on this computer
